faq.q: What should I check before removing subjects on a Maple Ridge condo?
faq.a: The strata package (Form B, depreciation report, minutes, insurance certificate) under the provincial strata framework — strata disputes can go to the Civil Resolution Tribunal — plus, for a building at the Port Haney river edge, the floodplain check: flood construction level 6.7 m geodetic and a covenant on title for floodplain construction.
